title: Ultimate Roasted British Salt Cod Cottage Pie
description: A comforting and creamy British dish featuring roasted salt cod, perfect for a sick day, made in a satvik-friendly and air-fryer adapted cottage pie form.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Air-fry the soaked and drained salt cod until golden brown.
In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until softened.
Add the minced garlic to the pan and cook for an additional minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked salt cod, sauteed onion and garlic, frozen peas, and mashed potatoes.
In a separate saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat and whisk in the flour to make a roux.
Slowly add the milk to the saucepan, whisking constantly, and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the salt and black pepper.
Pour the sauce over the salt cod mixture and stir until combined.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with additional mashed potatoes if desired.
Bake the cottage pie in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the potatoes are golden brown.
